description: Team deliverables bulletin board with GitHub as backend storage

personas.name: System Administrator
personas.description: Project manager or team lead responsible for coordinating architecture deliverables
goals: Post clear task requirements with all necessary context
Monitor progress of all active tasks
Receive timely notifications for critical events
pain_points: Difficulty tracking who is working on what
Losing important artifacts in email threads
No central place to view all deliverables

personas.name: Solution Architect
personas.description: Technical architect responsible for creating architecture deliverables and documentation
goals: Take ownership of tasks matching expertise
Upload deliverable artifacts with proper versioning
pain_points: No version history when iterating on deliverables

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: GitHub OAuth-based authentication for admins and architects

user_stories.i_want: to log in using my GitHub account
user_stories.so_that: I can securely access the bulletin board without creating separate credentials
acceptance_criteria: User sees Login with GitHub button on landing page
Clicking button redirects to GitHub OAuth authorization
After authorization, user is redirected back to application
User role determined based on GitHub username configuration
Session persists across browser refreshes
User can log out

features.name: Bulletin Board Display
features.description: View, search, and filter all bulletin posts

user_stories.i_want: to see all bulletin posts in a list view
user_stories.so_that: I can understand the current team workload and priorities
acceptance_criteria: Bulletin board displays all posts
Each post card shows title, status, assigned architects, created date
Posts sorted by created date newest first
Closed posts are grayed out but visible
Active posts prominently displayed

user_stories.i_want: to search and filter bulletin posts
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly find specific tasks or deliverables
acceptance_criteria: Search box filters posts by title, description, concerned parties
Filter dropdown for status
Filter dropdown for assigned architect
Date range filter
Multiple filters can be applied simultaneously
Clear all filters button

features.name: Post Management (Admin)
features.description: Create, edit, delete, and manage bulletin posts

user_stories.i_want: to create a new bulletin post
user_stories.so_that: I can assign architecture deliverables to the team
acceptance_criteria: Create New Post button visible to admins only
Form includes required fields: Title, Description, Concerned Parties
File attachment field accepts one or more files (max 10MB each)
Image attachments show preview thumbnails
Architect dropdown allows selecting multiple architects
Status dropdown with default value New
Created date auto-populated
Form validation prevents submission with missing fields

user_stories.i_want: to edit an existing bulletin post
user_stories.so_that: I can update requirements or correct mistakes
acceptance_criteria: Edit button visible on post detail page for admins
Edit form pre-populated with existing data
All fields editable
Can add new attachments
Can remove existing attachments
Changes saved to GitHub repository

user_stories.i_want: to delete a bulletin post
user_stories.so_that: I can remove cancelled or duplicate tasks
acceptance_criteria: Delete button visible on post detail page for admins
Confirmation dialog shown before deletion
Post and all associated attachments removed from GitHub
Associated conversations and artifacts also deleted

user_stories.i_want: to change the status of a post
user_stories.so_that: I can reflect the current state of the deliverable
acceptance_criteria: Status dropdown visible on post detail page for admins
Can select from: New, Assigned-InProgress, Submitted for Review, Pending Review, Escalate, Closed
Changing to Escalate triggers notification to all admins
Changing to Closed marks closed date and captures admin name
Only admins can move status to Closed

user_stories.i_want: to assign or reassign architects to a post
user_stories.so_that: I can distribute work based on expertise and availability
acceptance_criteria: Architect dropdown on post detail page (admins only)
Can select multiple architects
Can add or remove architects from assignment
Admin-assigned tasks are locked

features.name: Task Assignment (Architect)
features.description: Self-assign to available tasks and view assignments

user_stories.i_want: to self-assign to an available task
user_stories.so_that: I can take ownership of deliverables matching my expertise
acceptance_criteria: Assign to Me button visible on unassigned or partially assigned posts
Clicking button adds architect to assigned list
Multiple architects can self-assign to same task
Cannot self-assign if admin has locked assignments
No notification sent to admin on self-assignment

user_stories.i_want: to distinguish between my assigned and unassigned tasks
user_stories.so_that: I can prioritize my work
acceptance_criteria: Assigned tasks highlighted with visual indicator
Filter option for My Tasks shows only assigned tasks
Unassigned tasks clearly marked as available

features.name: Artifact Management
features.description: Upload and manage deliverable artifacts with version control

user_stories.i_want: to upload deliverable artifacts
user_stories.so_that: I can submit my work for review
acceptance_criteria: Upload button visible on assigned tasks only
File upload supports multiple files (max 10MB each)
Version number auto-incremented (v1, v2, v3, etc.)
Upload timestamp and uploader name recorded
Files saved to GitHub repository under task folder

user_stories.i_want: to view all versions of uploaded artifacts
user_stories.so_that: I can track iterations and access previous versions
acceptance_criteria: Artifact section shows list of all versions
Each version shows: version number, uploaded by, upload date, file name
Latest version highlighted as Current
Image files show thumbnail preview
Can download any version

user_stories.i_want: to add notes explaining my deliverable
user_stories.so_that: admins understand my approach and decisions
acceptance_criteria: Multi-line text area visible on assigned tasks
Can add/edit notes multiple times
Notes saved to GitHub with timestamp
Notes visible to admin and assigned architects only

features.name: Conversation Threads
features.description: Threaded conversations between admins and architects

user_stories.i_want: to ask questions about a bulletin post
user_stories.so_that: I can get clarification before or during work
acceptance_criteria: Chat/comment section visible on all posts
Architect can add comment even before assignment
Comment includes message text, author name, timestamp
Comments saved to GitHub repository
Comments visible only to admin and assigned architects

user_stories.i_want: to reply to comments in the thread
user_stories.so_that: we can have structured discussions
acceptance_criteria: Reply button on each comment
Reply indented or threaded under parent comment
Thread depth limited to 2 levels
All participants in thread can see replies

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Notify admins of critical events (escalations, closures)

user_stories.i_want: to receive notification when a task is closed
user_stories.so_that: I am aware of completed deliverables
acceptance_criteria: Notification triggered when task status changed to Closed
Notification shows task title, closed by, closed date
Notification visible in notification center/panel
Unread notification count shown in header

user_stories.i_want: to receive notification when a task is escalated
user_stories.so_that: I can address urgent issues quickly
acceptance_criteria: Notification triggered when task status changed to Escalate
Notification marked as high priority
All admins receive the notification
Clicking notification navigates to task detail

features.name: Control Panel (Admin Configuration)
features.description: Manage system configuration including architects, statuses, and task limit settings

user_stories.i_want: to manage the list of architects
user_stories.so_that: I can control who can be assigned to tasks
acceptance_criteria: Control panel accessible to admins only
View list of all architects
Add new architect by GitHub username
Remove architect (with warning if assigned to active tasks)
Activate/deactivate architect
Architect list stored as JSON file in GitHub repository

user_stories.i_want: to customize the available task statuses
user_stories.so_that: I can adapt the workflow to team needs
acceptance_criteria: View list of all status values
Add new custom status
Edit status label and description
Cannot delete statuses in use
Status list stored as JSON file in GitHub repository

user_stories.i_want: to customize the message shown when task limit is reached
user_stories.so_that: I can provide context-specific guidance to the team
acceptance_criteria: Text editor for banner message
Preview of banner as it will appear
Banner message stored in GitHub configuration file
Banner appears when active task count reaches 50

features.name: Archive and Export
features.description: Archive completed tasks and export data for compliance

user_stories.i_want: to archive completed tasks
user_stories.so_that: the bulletin board remains focused on active work
acceptance_criteria: Archive button visible on closed tasks
Bulk archive option
Archived tasks moved to separate Archive view
Archived tasks not counted toward 50-task limit
Archived tasks remain searchable
Can unarchive tasks if needed

user_stories.i_want: to export tasks and artifacts as archive file
user_stories.so_that: I can maintain offline records for compliance
acceptance_criteria: Export button generates downloadable archive (ZIP)
Archive includes all task data (JSON), artifacts, conversations
Can export all tasks or selected date range
Export includes metadata (export date, exported by)

features.name: Image Preview
features.description: Preview image attachments inline without downloading

user_stories.i_want: to preview image attachments inline
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly review diagrams without downloading
acceptance_criteria: Image files (PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG) display as thumbnails
Clicking thumbnail opens full-size preview modal
Modal includes zoom controls
Non-image files show file type icon
Preview works for images in attachments and artifacts

statuses.name: New
statuses.description: Task created but not yet assigned or started

statuses.name: Assigned-InProgress
statuses.description: Task assigned to architect(s) and work is in progress

statuses.name: Submitted for Review
statuses.description: Architect has submitted deliverable for admin review

statuses.name: Escalate
statuses.description: Task is blocked or requires urgent attention

statuses.name: Closed
statuses.description: Task completed and approved by admin

constraints: Must use GitHub as backend storage
Limited to GitHub API rate limits (5000 requests/hour authenticated)
File size limited to 10MB per file
Designed for small teams (5 users initially)
assumptions: Users are comfortable with GitHub authentication
Users have modern Chrome browser installed
Task volume remains under 100 total (50 active + archived)
Desktop-only usage is acceptable for v1
